# fw mcp

> Reference of the fw mcp command: Serve fw's tools as an MCP server over stdio, or manage client MCP servers in ~/.fx/mcp.json. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/mcp/

Serve fw's tools as an MCP server over stdio, or manage client MCP servers in ~/.fx/mcp.json

## Usage

```bash
fw mcp | fw mcp <list|add|remove>
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw mcp list
fw mcp add
fw mcp remove
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
